summary: Plan finalized: single workflow_dispatch release.yml (gh CLI + npm version + atomic push, PAT-authenticated) plus one minimal releasing guide; incorporated the owner's authoritative answer (RELEASE_PAT 90-day scope, dry_run, one-doc-only) and dropped the Run-1 CONTRIBUTING edit.

decisions.summary: Release quality gate mirrors CI's lint job including the bundled-docs sync check, not just bare pnpm lint.
decisions.chosen: Gate = pnpm lint + bundled-docs sync (pnpm run docs:bundle + git diff --exit-code) + pnpm test (unit) + pnpm build, all before any mutation.
decisions.reasoning: Faithfully mirrors the existing CI lint job so a release can never be cut from a state CI would reject; the sync check is cheap and aborts cleanly before any commit/tag. Research explicitly left whether to include it open.

decisions.summary: Register the single releasing guide in the VitePress sidebar and contribution-docs index.
decisions.chosen: Two one-line edits to existing files (docs/.vitepress/config.ts Contributing sidebar + docs/contribution-docs/README.md How-Tos list) so the guide isn't an orphaned page.
decisions.reasoning: Owner asked for exactly one new doc and minimal footprint; these are not new docs but the standard registration every how-to gets, needed so the single guide is discoverable in site nav. Surfaced in case the owner wants zero edits to other files.

decisions.summary: Add one additive pointer sentence in the README Versioning section linking to the releasing guide.
decisions.chosen: A single sentence pointer; existing npm-deferred / reset-is-the-upgrade-path / GitHub-releases narrative left intact.
decisions.reasoning: Owner permitted a one-line README pointer 'if actually needed'; judged needed for discoverability from the most-read doc and for acceptance-criterion-9 consistency. Trivially removable.

settled_by_owner_not_resurfaced: RELEASE_PAT: fine-grained, this repo only, Contents read/write, 90-day expiry, stored as RELEASE_PAT secret (owner provisions before first run).
dry_run: boolean input, default false, ends after computing version and previewing notes.
details.owner_prerequisite_before_first_run: Create the RELEASE_PAT Actions secret per the releasing guide; documented, not a blocker to writing the workflow/doc.
